message:
3 speaking attributes carry a string written inline:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:32: value="Delete the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:33: value="Delete the row"

description: The `value` written on text fields: one with no type, an e-mail field, and one of a type the browser does not know, which it makes a text field (measured in Chromium 152: each shows the word). Written, the value is a speaking attribute as a button's is, and the refusal counts three.
